name: Cash-in-hand subcontractor under-declaring tax
description: Subcontractor paid in cash or via informal rails, then under-declares income / employment tax. Entity may be facilitating.

name: Fictitious supplier / ghost invoicing chain
description: Supplier invoices for goods or services that are not delivered; recipients claim VAT / costs.

name: MTIC / VAT-carousel exposure
description: Entity's transactions form part of a missing-trader / carousel chain; HMRC denies VAT recovery.

name: Offshore re-routing of revenue
description: Entity assists customer / supplier in re-routing revenue offshore to avoid domestic tax.

name: Failure of CFA Reasonable Procedures
description: UK CFA 2017 / equivalent: prosecution turns on absence of reasonable prevention procedures.
